title: Comet
definition: Comets are icy, small solar system bodies that, when passing close to the Sun, warm up and begin to release gases, a process known as outgassing, producing a visible atmosphere or coma, and sometimes a tail.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under Science and Technology (Cosmic Physics, Space Missions) regarding astronomical terminology, orbital characteristics, origin of the solar system, and interplanetary space probes.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Comet structures, orbits, and origins.
Evaluate spatial distribution like the Kuiper Belt and Oort Cloud, alongside space mission interventions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding comet tails and classifications.
